from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentCase(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document extracted with its key classification information."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str = Field(description="The cause of action or case nature identified in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all judgment documents found in the collection."""
    documents: list[JudgmentCase]
